meta.universe_note: n_universe=7 resolves (train-window-locked, top-N-by-coverage) to XBT/USD, /USDTEUR, XBT/EUR, ETH/USD, LTC/EUR, LTC/USD, XRP/USD — i.e. FOUR distinct underlyings (BTC, ETH, LTC, XRP) listed against two quote currencies plus one stablecoin FX pair (/USDTEUR).
